title: Nonnegative decoding edge value
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game, let each vertex be assigned a bounded real-valued function on its Boolean cube, and choose a real threshold $\varepsilon$ and a default label. For every vertex and each neighbor of that vertex, the ordinary decoding edge value determined by the table, threshold, and default label is nonnegative.
hypotheses_covered: G is a regular unique game
A bounded long-code table is given
A real threshold ε is given
A vertex and one of its neighbors are given
